title: Command palette (ctrl+p)
brief: Command palette of goop opened with ctrl+p, modeled on opencode's DialogSelect: a centered ~720px dialog on --background-panel (no border, no radius) over the dimmed, inert 04 session, which keeps its status line with the commands focus mode. Header inset 4 cells: bold Commands left, muted esc right; search input below (placeholder Search, auto-focused, lavender cursor); list grouped by bold --accent category headers indented 3 cells (Suggested, Offers, Search, Session, Agents & models, System), rows with title, optional muted inline description and right-aligned muted keybind; selected row filled --primary with bold --background text; ● gutter in --primary for an active item. Main frame shows the query 'of' flattened to matches with bold matched letters and the category instead of the keybind on the right. Bottom hint row: bold action, muted key (select ↵ · move ↑↓ · close esc) and ctrl+p on the right. Below the screen: the unfiltered grouped list and the No results found state.

artboards.title: Dialog
artboards.tradeoff: One keystroke reaches every action and the categories teach the slash commands, but the dialog hides the conversation while open, the unfiltered list scrolls at 900px, and the filled orange selection and bold-action hint row are palette-only exceptions to the system rules
